verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Typesense Cloud is the hosted version of the open-source product. They state that the complete API surface ships in the GPL-3.0 open-source server, so you can self-host the same engine Cloud runs, including Raft-based HA. Self-hosting is well supported, with install paths for Docker, Kubernetes, DEB/RPM, binaries and Terraform, plus production best-practice guides. Missing for 10: self-hosted equivalents of Cloud's platform extras (Search Delivery Network, visual dashboard, SSO/RBAC, auto scaling), and independent hands-on reports of running a self-hosted cluster at parity with Cloud.
